statements.impact_statement: The issue is confined to the gif2rgb command-line utility. Direct-Xfer does not install or invoke gif2rgb.
The historical issue applies to the Solaris NSS implementation, not Debian's Mozilla NSS library.
Direct-Xfer invokes only tesseract, pdftotext and pdftoppm. The unused pdftocairo and text2image executables are removed during the image build.
